steps.title: Outline the notes
steps.prompt: The lecture {{inputs.lecture}} is in {{run.dir}}/slides as text and one page image per slide. Write {{run.dir}}/outline.md: the sections, the slides each covers, and the key terms. No notes yet.

steps.title: Write the notes
steps.prompt: From {{run.dir}}/outline.md and {{run.dir}}/slides, write {{run.dir}}/notes.md: summary lines, terms, one worked example and self-test questions. Every line cites its slide as p.N.

steps.title: Check every line against its slide
steps.prompt: Check each line of {{run.dir}}/notes.md against the slide it cites in {{run.dir}}/slides. Rewrite an unsourced line from a slide or cut it, once. Every slide is cited or skipped with a reason. Write the result to {{run.dir}}/CHECK.md. Set passed to true when no unsourced line is left, otherwise false. Set unsourced to true when any line is still unsourced after the rewrite, otherwise false.

steps.title: Proof every page
steps.prompt: Look at each page of {{run.dir}}/out/{{inputs.name}}.pdf. No table or example split across pages, no heading alone at a page foot, no clipped line. Fix problems in {{run.dir}}/print.css and list them in {{run.dir}}/PROOF.md. Set passed to true when every page is clean, otherwise false.

steps.title: Read the PDF, then Continue
steps.gate_summary: Read {{run.dir}}/out/{{inputs.name}}.pdf. Continue keeps the PDF; reject cancels the run.
